blocks.text: The Philippine animated film “Ella Arcangel: Awit ng Pangil at Kuko” won two major honors at the 14th QCinema International Film Festival. The film took home the Grand Jury Prize and the Artistic Achievement Award under the Asian Next Wave category. Furthermore, the project earned a prestigious nomination for Best Picture during the event.
